name_en: Iimochi — leftover rice mixed with wheat dough and pan-grilled into cakes
summary_ja: 残りご飯に小麦粉を混ぜて丸め、平たく焼いた埼玉の軽食。手作業の農作業で忙しかった時代、朝作って田んぼへ弁当代わりに持って行けた手軽さが重宝された。呼び名は地域で異なる。
summary_en: Leftover rice kneaded with wheat flour, shaped and pan-grilled flat, a Saitama snack. In an era of hand-worked farming, it could be made in the morning and carried to the fields like a packed lunch. Names for it vary by area.
source_title: 飯餅｜うちの郷土料理｜農林水産省
